title: Nice bowls, but not microwave safe...
text:
Nice bowls, but not microwave safe.... These are nice bowls with great color, but NOT microwave safe. We usually cook our Ramen noodles in the microwave, but can’t with these. They are dishwasher safe though.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
